Body.Content:
What and Why:

New VDI optimization for Omnissa on Mac. This feature allows Mac endpoints to optimize Microsoft Teams in VDI environments with the new SlimCore-based media engine, providing an expanded feature set and multiple improvements in quality, reliability and performance.

Rollout Schedule:

Global: We will begin rolling out on early December 2026 and expect to complete by early February 2027.

Impact on Your Organization:

With this release, a new media engine delivers a better user experience that is aligned with the rich feature set and performance native Mac Teams users have.

Action Required/Recommendations:

Upgrade your Horizon Client for Mac to an upcoming release (2609.1 or higher). Upgrade Teams to 26304.1207.5384.858 or higher.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: A new VDI optimization for Omnissa on Mac using a SlimCore-based media engine will enhance Microsoft Teams' quality, reliability, and performance. Rollout starts December 2026 to February 2027. Upgrade Horizon Client (2609.1+) and Teams (26304.1207.5384.858+) to benefit. No compliance issues noted.

Title: New VDI solution for Omnissa on Mac
